post.summary: Bind a published reading article from the frozen owner version
post.description: 内容所有者内部写入口。只绑定当前已发布版本上已经冻结的 readingArticle 与 gradableQuestions，调用方不能提交文章或题目数据，也不自动分配 articleId 或 itemId。本阶段没有 Gateway 投影，也没有 /api/v1 公开孪生路径。PUBLISH 仍负责移动发布指针，并仍要求 LEARNER 与 PUBLIC。既有 B9 命令字段与行为不变。

x-contract.assignment: none. articleId and each itemId stay the owner-authored exact decimals already frozen on the current version. This operation does not auto-assign, rewrite, or compose them.
x-contract.securitySchemeSource: existing IAM access token already used by admin content operations
x-contract.permission: actual verified content:publish is required. A content-publisher role, or any other role, without that permission does not authorize this operation. content-editor, reviewer-l1, reviewer-l2, and release-operator scopes do not authorize it. Existing submitB9ContentCommand authorization is unchanged.
x-contract.publisher: the same verified IAM subject must equal the stored publisher. A role match does not replace the content:publish permission or the stored publisher.
x-contract.rejectedAuthority: X-Role, X-B5-Role, and any caller actor, tenant, owner, role, or permission field are not authority and are not accepted
x-contract.actors: stored editor, first reviewer, final reviewer, and publisher are non-blank and pairwise distinct. This request does not accept or invent them.
x-contract.tenant: server platform tenant. The caller cannot select it.
x-contract.publicationPointer: unchanged. PUBLISH remains the pointer move and still requires LEARNER and PUBLIC.

x-idempotency.scope: verified content:publish subject equal to the stored publisher, the Idempotency-Key, and the byte digest of contentCode, contentVersionId, expectedHash, and expectedStateVersion
x-idempotency.replayBehavior: First commit is the only write of the binding. It returns replayed false and stores replayed false. A same-key replay is the same verified publisher, the same Idempotency-Key, and the same request digest: it writes nothing, leaves the stored receipt, experience rows, binding rows, and payload digest unchanged, and the returned replayed flag changes to true while every other returned field stays the stored receipt. The stored replayed value does not change. The same Idempotency-Key with a different digest returns 409 READING_BINDING_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, writes nothing, and returns no replayed flag.
x-idempotency.returnedReplayedFlag: false only on first commit. On same-key replay the returned flag changes to true and the stored flag stays false. A different digest does not return the flag. An exact current-version byte match under a new Idempotency-Key also writes no experience or binding row and returns replayed true, only when x-cross-owner allows that match.

x-cas.sameIdentity: contentVersionId is the current published version of the definition identified by contentCode
x-cas.expectedStateVersionZero: rejected. A published aggregate uses a state version starting at 1.

x-rights.sealedOnly: rejected. Historical SEALED is an assessment grant only together with LEARNER. It is not sufficient alone.
x-rights.publishUnchanged: PUBLISH still requires LEARNER and PUBLIC. This predicate does not change that command.
x-rights.withdrawal: inactive copyright, learning not allowed, blank source, license, or evidence, or a closed rights window fails closed and writes nothing

200.description: First commit returns replayed false. A same-key replay, or an exact current-version byte match, returns the stored receipt with only the returned replayed flag changed to true. Stored rows and the payload digest are not rewritten.

400.description: Request syntax or closed-field validation failed. Writes nothing.

401.description: IAM access token is missing, invalid, expired, or revoked. Writes nothing.

403.description: Actual verified content:publish and the same stored publisher are both required. Role-only authorization, invalid stored four-actor facts, or the reading rights predicate failed. Writes nothing.

409.description: CAS, identity, idempotency, stored article, stored questions, reserved key, different-version key, mismatched experience, type, or status, or cross-owner key failed. Writes nothing. The old row is not flipped to REVOKED and is not reused in place.

post.summary: Idempotent batch import of content drafts (M3-002 live duel)

x-contract.fieldFiltering: admin role-specific fields; no direct database projection

x-idempotency.replayBehavior: same actor and batch key returns the original per-item results; existing codes report SKIPPED

post.description: Each entry carries contentCode (pack) plus exactly one of content (pack draft), lexeme (word-master upsert) or item (row-level upsert). Entries are keyed {batchKey}:item:{index}:{code} so replay never duplicates.

x-contract.fieldFiltering: admin role-specific fields; never mutates content or emits projections; records only an idempotency report receipt

x-idempotency.replayBehavior: same actor, key and request body return the original report and checkedAt; different body with the same key returns 409

B9ContentVersionSummary.description: 内容版本的只读摘要。canonical 持久状态只有 DRAFT、IN_REVIEW、APPROVED、PUBLISHED、ARCHIVED；UNPUBLISHED 和 ROLLED_BACK 仅为旧 v1 响应的 deprecated compatibility aliases，新实现不得产生。

status.description: UNPUBLISHED/ROLLED_BACK 仅用于读取旧 v1 数据，新实现不得产生。

licenseCode.description: Admin-only reference; public projections expose only a rights status.

stimulusRef.description: Opaque reference to a content stimulus; answer material is not carried here.

definition.description: Service-owned structured definition. Public projection is generated by an allow-list, never by copying this object.

answerRuleVersion.description: Opaque internal version used only by assessment-service; never emitted in public or learner projections.

permittedChannels.description: 编辑提交的待核验发行渠道申报；仅 L2 终审 APPROVED 才能将其激活为版权事实，客户端永远不能直接写入 ACTIVE 状态。

authorizationEvidenceRef.description: 授权证据引用（自有版权声明、开放许可文本或合法授权凭证编号）；终审激活时服务端核对非空，证据原文不出投影。

allowsLearning.description: 编辑申报的学习使用许可；仅为待核验申报，终审前不产生任何授权效力。

gradableQuestions.description: 可选的管理端输入，只随既有 submitB9ContentCommand 的 CREATE_DRAFT 或 SAVE_DRAFT 中的 content 提交。省略时新版本不携带可判分题，必填 items 保持原语义，不得从 items 或 kind QUESTION 推断本题。出现时为 1 至 100 道闭集题，上限与 B10CreateAssessmentSessionRequest.itemIds 的 maxItems 100 相同；数组顺序即该版本的稳定题序，服务端不得按 itemId 重排或改号。同一版本数组内 itemId 必须互异。itemId 按 JSON 整数精确比较，optionId 与 correctOption 按码位精确比较，不做去空白、大小写折叠或重新分配。写入后本题成为该 contentVersionId 的不可变 payload 字节；SAVE_DRAFT 只追加新版本，不得改写已创建版本的 id、题干、选项或答案。既有提交审核、不同人的一审与二审、版权在 L2 激活前保持 PENDING，以及 PUBLISH 所需的独立编辑、两名审核人、发布者、LEARNER 与 PUBLIC 权利均不因本字段改变或豁免。命令 contentCode 精确等于 p1.placement.v1，或内容标识精确等于 p1-placement-bank-v1 时必须拒绝；本题不是 content_placement_item，不得扩写密封题库。answerRule 只供服务端保留在版本 payload，本契约不把它加入学习者、公开、评估快照或管理端响应。运行时支持仅为 Content authoring-only：既有单条 CREATE_DRAFT 与 SAVE_DRAFT 写入不可变版本 payload，assessment 与阅读运行时仍不读取。
gradableQuestions.x-optional-absence: omitted means the new version has no gradableQuestions; required items stay unchanged and are not inferred into this array
gradableQuestions.x-question-order: array order is the stable display order for that content version
gradableQuestions.x-id-stability: exact integer itemId and exact-case optionId; no trim, case-fold, or server reallocation
gradableQuestions.x-version-immutability: contentVersionId and payload bytes are immutable after creation; a later SAVE_DRAFT allocates a new version
gradableQuestions.x-review-rights-publish: existing review, PENDING-until-L2 rights, and PUBLISH actor and LEARNER plus PUBLIC rights rules stay in force
gradableQuestions.x-sealed-bank: rejected extension of p1.placement.v1 and content_placement_item
gradableQuestions.x-answer-retention: server-only immutable version payload; absent from learner, public, assessment-snapshot, and admin response schemas
gradableQuestions.x-runtime-gap: Content authoring-only: single CREATE_DRAFT and SAVE_DRAFT persist gradableQuestions on the immutable version payload. Assessment and reading runtimes do not read gradableQuestions.

readingArticle.description: 可选。只随既有 CREATE_DRAFT 或 SAVE_DRAFT 的 content 提交。省略表示该版本没有阅读文章。importB9ContentBatch 拒绝本字段，且批量导入不是发布或 B3 绑定。此元数据不修改 B9ContentCommandRequest 的字段、枚举、oneOf 或 x-command-field-policy。

B9GradableQuestionInput.description: 管理端草稿中的一道闭集可判分题。只含 itemId、stem、options 与 answerRule。不是 ContentItemUpsertInput 的 qi_ 行，也不替换 B9ContentItemDefinition。

itemId.description: JSON 整数，含端点 1 与 9007199254740991。下限与 B10Int64Id 一致，上限是可往返的安全整数。禁止字符串、小数、前导零和 qi_ 前缀。同一 gradableQuestions 数组内必须唯一，并在所属 contentVersionId 上保持不变。

stem.description: 非空白题干。长度上限与 B10LearnerContentItem.stem 的 4096 一致。仅空白字符非法。

options.description: 有序选项，2 至 8 个。数组顺序即展示顺序，服务端不得重排。同一题内 optionId 必须唯一，并按精确大小写比较。
options.x-option-order: array order is the stable display order

B9GradableQuestionOptionInput.description: 闭集选项。optionId 是不透明令牌，label 是非空白展示文案。

optionId.description: 不透明选项令牌，模式与 B10ContentItemOption.optionId 相同。精确大小写，长度 1 至 64，不得折叠，也不得用作文案或答案正文。

label.description: 非空白选项文案。长度上限与 B10ContentItemOption.label 的 512 一致。仅空白字符非法。

B9GradableQuestionAnswerRuleInput.description: 闭集答案，且只能包含 correctOption。correctOption 必须与本题某个 optionId 精确相等。不得携带 acceptedKeys、correctKey、answer 或 explanation。答案只保留在服务端不可变版本 payload 中，不进入本契约的任何响应。

correctOption.description: 必须精确等于本题 options 里的一个 optionId。大小写敏感，成员检查由服务端执行。

B9GradableQuestionAnswerRuleInput.x-answer-member-check: correctOption exact-case member of the same question options[].optionId

B9ReadingArticleBlockInput.description: 阅读文章的一块作者输入。只含 contentLocale 下的纯文本，以及可选的单条对照译文。blockId、blockIndex、token 和分支由服务端派生或不接收。

text.description: 该版本 contentLocale 下的纯文本。长度上限与 B10LearnerContentItem.stem 以及 B9 公开 displayText 的 4096 一致。不得提交 token、HTML 对象或分支选项。仅空白字符非法。学习者解析只保留含文本的块。

translation.description: 可选的单条对照译文，只属于本块。省略表示没有译文。不是 locale 映射，不另带 contentLocale，也不携带答案、演员或租户。长度上限同样是 4096。仅空白字符非法。

B9ReadingArticleAuthoring.description: 可选的管理端输入，只随既有 submitB9ContentCommand 的 CREATE_DRAFT 或 SAVE_DRAFT 中的 content 提交。省略表示新版本没有阅读文章；必填 items 与可选 gradableQuestions 保持原语义，不得从 items、title 或散落的 articleId/blocks 推断本文。版本 payload 只应白名单 summary、contentLocale、targetLevel、items、gradableQuestions 和本对象，因此未命名的 articleId 或 blocks 不会留下。出现时成为该 contentVersionId 的不可变 payload 字节；SAVE_DRAFT 只追加新版本。批量导入不接收本字段。客户端只提交 articleId 与 blocks。title 复制必填草稿 title，cefrLevel 复制必填 targetLevel，wordCount 由块文本按单个空格连接再按单个空格拆分得到，与既有阅读种子的 wordCount 算法相同。blockId 为 block- 加从 1 起的序号，blockIndex 为从 0 起的数组下标。contentVersionId 由所分配版本写入体验行，并写入投影 payload 以便既有版本一致性检查。不接收 estimatedMinutes、rightsStatus、practiceRef、token、分支、答案、规则、演员或租户；学习者解析对缺省 estimatedMinutes 使用 5，对缺省 rightsStatus 使用 AUTHORIZED。articleId 必须是与同内容 gradableQuestions.itemId 都不同的安全整数，且不得为保留旧键 3501 或 3950，也不得落入 266001 至 266010。同内容的 itemId 也不得取这些保留值。命令 contentCode 精确等于 p1.placement.v1，或内容标识精确等于 p1-placement-bank-v1 时必须拒绝。本对象不规定可判分题的道数，也不进入学习者、公开、评估快照或管理端响应。
B9ReadingArticleAuthoring.x-optional-absence: omitted means the new version has no readingArticle; required items and optional gradableQuestions stay unchanged and are not inferred into this object
B9ReadingArticleAuthoring.x-version-immutability: contentVersionId and payload bytes are immutable after creation; a later SAVE_DRAFT allocates a new version
B9ReadingArticleAuthoring.x-batch-import: rejected; single CREATE_DRAFT and SAVE_DRAFT only
B9ReadingArticleAuthoring.x-response-absence: absent from learner, public, assessment-snapshot, and admin response schemas
B9ReadingArticleAuthoring.x-word-count: join block text with one space, then split on one space; same derivation as the existing reading seed wordCount
B9ReadingArticleAuthoring.x-block-identity: server assigns block-{1-based index} and 0-based blockIndex from array order
B9ReadingArticleAuthoring.x-article-id-independent-of-question-ids: articleId exact integer inequality against every gradableQuestions itemId in the same content object

x-rejected-numeric-id-range.reason: placement item ids and legacy dangling reading keys stay reserved

B9ReadingArticleAuthoring.x-item-count: R1-044 does not set this object's question cardinality. GrammarReadingPack.required(READING) is 2 only for an unnamed assessment pack and returns CLOSED_MISSING when shorter; named itemIds stay as given. gradableQuestions remains omitted or 1 to 100.

articleId.description: JSON 整数，含端点 1 与 9007199254740991。下限与 B10Int64Id 一致，上限是可往返的安全整数。禁止字符串、小数和前导零。必须与同一次 content.gradableQuestions 的每个 itemId 不同。不得为 3501 或 3950，不得落入 266001 至 266010。

blocks.description: 至少一块。上限与同一 B9ContentDraftInput.items 的 maxItems 10000 相同。数组顺序即稳定块序。B3 学习者解析保留每一块非空白 text，本上限只封闭作者输入。

B9ReadingBindingRequest.description: 发布绑定只提交当前所有者版本的身份和 CAS。不接收文章、题目、答案、演员、租户、角色或权限。服务端只读取该版本已经冻结的 payload。
B9ReadingBindingRequest.x-identity: contentCode and contentVersionId must name the same content definition. The version must be that definition's current published version. A key owned by a different content_code, or by any other content_version_id of this content_code including an archived version, is not adopted.

contentCode.description: 已发布内容定义的代码。必须与 contentVersionId 所属定义相同。

contentVersionId.description: 期望的 current_published_version_id。不是 targetVersionNumber，也不是客户端分配的新版本。

expectedHash.description: 该已发布版本已存储的 payload hash，64 位十六进制。不是草稿 content.contentHash，也不是排期快照里的 contentHash。

expectedStateVersion.description: 内容聚合的当前状态版本。已发布聚合从 1 起，0 被拒绝且不写入。此收紧只属于本请求，不修改 B9ExpectedStateVersion。

B9ReadingBindingPracticeRef.description: 内容所有者回执里的答题坐标。字段与既有 B3 阅读读取写入的 practiceRef 相同，但不引用其他所有者的 schema。questionItemId 是文章绑定行的 question_item_id，为冻结 gradableQuestions 第一个 itemId 的十进制文本，绝不是 articleId。不含题干、选项或答案。

questionItemId.description: 第一个已存储题目 itemId 的无前导零十进制文本。

B9ReadingBindingReceipt.description: 一次内容所有者事务的回执。标识来自冻结版本，不回显文章正文、题干、选项或答案。首次提交返回 replayed false，存储回执也保持 false。同一已授权发布者、同一幂等键和同一请求摘要的重放不改存储回执、体验行、绑定行或 payload 摘要；返回体只有 replayed 从存储的 false 变为 true，其余字段与存储回执相同。
B9ReadingBindingReceipt.x-caller-content: absent. The request cannot supply article or question data.
B9ReadingBindingReceipt.x-bindings: one READING_ARTICLE plus one READING_QUESTION per stored gradableQuestions entry, in array order. The article question_item_id is the first itemId and never articleId. Count is the stored array length, not 2.
B9ReadingBindingReceipt.x-experience-ids: experience_id is b3-reading-article-{articleId} for READING_ARTICLE and b3-reading-question-{itemId} for each READING_QUESTION, using the canonical decimal with no leading zero. resource_key is that same exact decimal articleId or itemId and nothing else. Mobile B3 detail loads the article with b.resource_key=? bound to the numeric articleId, so a composite, prefixed, versioned, or content-coded key would miss. An existing article or question key conflicts and writes nothing when any different content_version_id owns it, including the same content_code and an archived version, when another content owns it, or when experience_id, resource_type, or status does not match. The exact current published version is allowed only when every stored field is byte-equivalent and the caller is the same authorized publisher with the same payload fingerprint. A newer published version that needs its own reading mapping uses distinct owner-authored numeric ids for the article and each item. This operation does not auto-assign those ids.
B9ReadingBindingReceipt.x-payload: server copies block text, stem, and options only. Question options map optionId to optionCode. answerRule and correctOption stay out. Payloads include articleId. content_version_id is this version.
B9ReadingBindingReceipt.x-cross-owner: unique key is tenant, domain, resource type, and resource key. resource_key stays the exact decimal articleId for READING_ARTICLE and the exact decimal itemId for READING_QUESTION. No composite key. A matching key owned by any different version, even the same content_code and even an archived version, by different content, or by a mismatched experience_id, resource_type, or status, returns 409 READING_BINDING_CROSS_OWNER_KEY and writes nothing. Do not flip that row to REVOKED and do not reuse it in place. The original row and its digest stay unchanged. Old links then fail closed through the current published pointer without this operation moving the pointer. No other owner key is adopted and no second row is inserted for a taken key. The only non-mutating success is the exact current published version when every stored field is byte-equivalent, the verified subject is the stored publisher, and the payload fingerprint equals expectedHash. That match returns replayed true and does not rewrite the stored replayed flag.

x-reserved.behavior: reject and write nothing. Do not republish, rebind, or use these as fixtures.

B9ReadingBindingReceipt.x-r1-044: GrammarReadingPack reading packs are FULL or ZERO. An unnamed reading selection needs 2 READING items or CLOSED_MISSING before its idempotency claim. Named itemIds stay as given. course-b25-basics and p1.placement.v1 are outside that pack. This binding does not apply that count and does not invent 2 questions.

payloadHash.description: 已核对的存储 payload hash，等于请求 expectedHash。

articleId.description: 冻结 readingArticle.articleId。请求体没有此字段。

articleQuestionItemId.description: READING_ARTICLE 行的 question_item_id，等于 questionItemIds 的第一项，不等于 articleId。

questionItemIds.description: 冻结 gradableQuestions 的 itemId 十进制文本，顺序与数组相同。至少一题，因为 question_item_id 不能为空。不补成 2。

replayed.description: 首次提交返回 false，存储回执保持 false。同一已授权发布者、同一幂等键和同一请求摘要的重放，返回值变为 true，存储值不变。精确当前版本的全字段字节等价重入同样返回 true。不同摘要的同一幂等键不返回本字段。

B9ReadingBindingError.description: 本操作专用的封闭错误。不复用或扩展 ErrorCode。message 不得回显文章正文、题干、选项、答案、演员或租户。

message.description: 失败说明。禁止回显文章正文、题干、选项、答案、演员或租户。

B9PublishScheduleInput.description: 排期发布的乐观绑定快照。客户端只能提交版本、校验报告、双审记录和版权快照的引用及版本；content-service 必须在接收时和到期执行时重新核对 owner facts，绑定字段本身不是授权或运行时事实。

B9ScheduledPublishTask.description: 服务端只读的排期发布任务。客户端不能提交、伪造或推进 status，也不能把任务状态当作运行时发布证明；处理、重试、失败和恢复沿用 M1-007 recovery 契约，不在 B9 复制第二套处理状态机。

requestId.description: 创建或幂等重放该任务的服务端 request correlation ID；客户端不能伪造。

traceId.description: 贯穿命令受理、排期执行和审计记录的服务端 trace correlation ID；客户端不能伪造。

recoveryTaskId.description: 仅为服务端已创建的 workflow 恢复引用；不表示恢复已执行或运行时成功。

B9ScheduledPublishTaskRef.description: 命令受理或后台状态中的排期任务只读引用。处理、重试和失败恢复由 M1-007 recovery 负责，不在此引用复制第二套状态机。

B9ContentCommandRequest.description: 命令只表达意图和资源版本；actor、tenant、owner、role、permission、reviewer 和版权事实均由服务端从已验证上下文与内容记录派生。

lexemeId.description: Target lexeme for LEXEME_* commands except LEXEME_UPSERT creation

itemId.description: Target item for ITEM_* commands except creation

targetType.description: Schedule target selector; PACK publishes the latest APPROVED pack version, LEXEME/ITEM publish the pinned row.

targetRef.description: Lexeme/item id for LEXEME/ITEM targets; defaults to contentCode for PACK.

cohort.description: Gray cohort label recorded on the schedule task and its execution receipt. Learner-side enforcement arrives in B4; until then the label is metadata, never a distribution Gate.

B9ValidationReport.description: 绑定不可变版本与哈希的服务端校验事实；客户端只能引用其 ID 做乐观绑定，重放与发布时服务端按版本+哈希重查，旧报告不能为新版本背书。

mediaRefs.description: 版本载荷中声明的媒体资产引用；为空表示纯文本版本，媒体门 vacuous 通过且可审计。

B9ContentCommandAccepted.description: 服务端生成的命令受理结果。排期命令只返回只读任务引用；任务 status 不是 runtime publication proof。

outboxEventId.description: Content-service Outbox event identity; publication is at-least-once and consumers deduplicate.

scheduledPublishTask.description: 仅 SCHEDULE_PUBLISH 或其幂等重放结果携带；CANCEL_SCHEDULED_PUBLISH 返回被取消任务的只读引用。

validationReport.description: 仅 VALIDATE_DRAFT 或其幂等重放结果携带；绑定不可变 contentVersionId/contentHash 的服务端校验事实。

availability.description: 公开投影只返回已发布版本；投影落后或重建期间通过 projectionStatus 表达，不降级为空列表或草稿。

projectionStatus.description: CURRENT 表示 watermark 已追上；STALE/PROCESSING 表示公开投影暂时落后或重建中，content-service 仍不得返回草稿。

B9LearnerContentProjection.x-field-filtering: LEARNER_V1 is PUBLIC_V1 plus server-computed access flags; no content answer rules

projectionStatus.description: 学习投影沿用公开已发布版本；STALE/PROCESSING 只说明 projection watermark，不泄露草稿或答案规则。

sessionPin.description: 已开始学习 session 的服务端版本 pin；缺失表示当前 session 尚未建立 pin。建立后不得静默切换到其他版本。

B9SessionContentPin.description: 学习 session 对内容版本的服务端固定关系。仅表达版本引用和可用性，不返回已移除内容正文、答案或版权证据；UNAVAILABLE 时客户端不得静默回退到其他版本。

status.description: AVAILABLE requires a verified public HTTPS downloadUrl. UNAVAILABLE and COMING_SOON may omit the URL.

downloadUrl.description: Absolute public HTTPS URL. When present, it must use a publicly reachable hostname or globally routable address; local, loopback, private, link-local, multicast, reserved and documentation targets are rejected.

B9PublicProjectionState.description: 公开投影水位状态。STALE/PROCESSING 只表示投影落后或重建中，不能把草稿或未授权版本标成 PUBLISHED。

B9AdminContentState.description: 内容后台状态。canonical 持久状态为 DRAFT/IN_REVIEW/APPROVED/PUBLISHED/ARCHIVED；旧 UNPUBLISHED/ROLLED_BACK 只读兼容且新实现不得产生。排期任务由服务端只读维护。

authorSubject.description: 仅向具备审核权限的后台投影提供；服务端仍必须独立拒绝作者自审。

latestStatus.description: UNPUBLISHED/ROLLED_BACK 仅为旧 v1 读取兼容值，新实现不得产生。

reviewSubmissionReady.description: 仅内容 owner 根据当前版本、PASS 校验事实、有效授权及必需媒体 READY/CLEAN 事实计算；缺少任一可信事实必须为 false。客户端不得以 rightsStatus 或自行提交的校验结果替代。

reviewSubmissionReason.description: 当前版本提交双审的首个阻断原因；只读提示，提交命令仍由 owner 重新判定。

validationReport.description: 当前版本与哈希绑定的最新服务端校验事实；无报告时缺席，客户端不得自造。

reviewRecords.description: 按 reviewStage 键控且物理顺序无语义的只读审核记录集合。空集合表示尚未审核；单条只能是 FIRST_REVIEW；双条必须各含一条 FIRST_REVIEW 与 FINAL_REVIEW。每条记录绑定不可变 contentVersionId/contentHash，FINAL_REVIEW 必须基于同一版本与哈希的 FIRST_REVIEW APPROVED。

scheduledPublishTask.description: 若存在待执行排期则返回只读任务引用；不会改变 publicProjection.availability。

lexeme.description: Present only on kind=LEXEME rows: the full word-master record with pronunciations.

item.description: Present only on kind=ITEM rows: the full row-level item record.

scheduledTasks.description: Scheduled publish tasks for this pack (SCHEDULED/CANCELLED/EXECUTED/FAILED).

answerRuleVersion.description: Opaque version identifier only; no answer rule body is returned.

LexemeSense.description: One word sense. At least one of meaningCn (legacy Chinese gloss, retained for compatibility) or meaningLocal (generic local-language gloss) is required; server-side validation rejects a sense carrying neither.

pos.description: Sense-level part of speech; B4 long forms accepted alongside historical abbreviations.

meaningCn.description: Legacy Chinese gloss slot. Retained for compatibility; new non-Chinese languages use meaningLocal.

meaningLocal.description: Generic local-language gloss slot (B4 multilingual ribbon). Carries the sense gloss in the lexeme language (e.g. French sens for fr-FR rows).

accent.description: Open accent tag (BCP-47 style, uppercase-normalized server-side). US/UK/SLOW remain the conventional English values; other languages register their own tags (e.g. FR-PARIS).

audioAssetId.description: media-service asset reference; bytes never flow through content-service

accent.description: Open accent tag (BCP-47 style, uppercase-normalized server-side). US/UK/SLOW remain the conventional English values.

LexemeUpsertInput.description: Row-level word master. Lexemes live under a vocabulary pack (contentCode, kind VOCABULARY); the pack is auto-provisioned on first LEXEME_UPSERT.

lexemeId.description: Omit to create; server derives lx_{headword} sequence

language.description: Lexeme language ribbon (BCP-47, e.g. en-US, fr-FR, de-DE). Omit to inherit en-US; legacy rows without a language read back as en-US. Vocabulary packs follow VOCAB-{LANG}-PHASE1 (e.g. VOCAB-FR-PHASE1).

items.description: Word-level part of speech. PRON/PREP/CONJ/INTERJ are the historical abbreviations (retained for compatibility); PRONOUN/PREPOSITION/CONJUNCTION/INTERJECTION are the converged long forms (B4).

phoneticUS.description: Legacy English-only phonetic slot. Retained for compatibility; new languages use pronunciation rows.

phoneticUK.description: Legacy English-only phonetic slot. Retained for compatibility; new languages use pronunciation rows.

gender.description: Grammatical gender (B4 morphology ribbon). Required for fr-* NOUN rows; French uses MASCULINE/FEMININE.

number.description: Grammatical number (B4 morphology ribbon). Required for fr-* NOUN rows (citation SINGULAR unless the lemma is plural-only).

grammaticalCase.description: Grammatical case (B4 morphology ribbon). French rows omit it; German nouns carry it when declined.

verbGroup.description: Conjugation class, e.g. FR-ER, FR-IR, FR-RE, FR-IRREGULAR.

conjugation.description: Verb conjugation class (B4 morphology ribbon). Required for fr-* VERB rows.

language.description: Lexeme language ribbon (BCP-47). Legacy rows without a language read back as en-US.

phoneticUS.description: Legacy English-only phonetic slot. Retained for compatibility; new languages use pronunciation rows.

phoneticUK.description: Legacy English-only phonetic slot. Retained for compatibility; new languages use pronunciation rows.

conjugation.description: Verb conjugation class (B4 morphology ribbon: verbGroup, irregular).

publishedFields.description: Last published fields snapshot; null when never published. The admin diff compares fields against this snapshot.

ContentItemUpsertInput.description: Row-level content item (question/example/grammar/passage/exercise/dictation/shadowing) under a pack. Rich configuration travels in fields and never requires DDL.

itemId.description: Omit to create; server derives it: prefix by kind

kind.description: DICTATION (listening dictation) and SHADOWING (speaking shadowing) are the B4 multilingual interaction kinds; both run the standard draft/review/publish lifecycle.

stem.description: Question stem / example sentence / grammar title / passage heading

fields.description: Extensible item configuration: options, answerRuleVersion, explanation, cefr, difficulty, audioAssetId, subtitle lines, tags.

kind.description: Row kind; DICTATION/SHADOWING are the B4 interaction kinds.
